welcome.greeting: Hi! I'm Ralph. Can you help me learn how you're feeling?

waiting.title: Hi {{name}}! Let's hang out while we wait.
waiting.subtitle: Play a game or just talk and rest with Ralph.
waiting.companionTitle: Don't feel like playing a game?
waiting.companionDesc: Just talk with Ralph about how you feel or your favourite hobbies — or rest quietly and Ralph will check on you every 12 minutes (unless muted).

hand.title: Which hand do you draw with?
hand.titleCyber: Operator check: which hand do you write with?

fireflyTap.title: Firefly Tap
fireflyTap.subtitle: Catch the glowing bugs for Ralph's lantern!
fireflyTap.cardDesc: Tap the glowing fireflies before they fly away to light up Ralph's lantern!
fireflyTap.instructions: Tap each glowing firefly as fast as you can before it flies away!
fireflyTap.doneBody: Ralph's lantern is super bright now. Thank you!

cyber.cardDesc: Connect nodes 1➔25 to boot up, then alternate 1➔A➔2➔B under the clock to unlock the VIP Wi-Fi code!
cyber.warmupDesc: Use {{hand}}. Drag your finger (or tap) to connect the glowing blue nodes in order from 1 to 25 as fast as you can to boot up the hack.
cyber.offhandDesc: Switch to {{hand}} for a quick 10-node sync before breaching the main firewall.
cyber.bypassDesc: The security grid now mixes numbers (1–13) and letters (A–L). Alternate your connections: 1 ➔ A ➔ 2 ➔ B ➔ 3 ➔ C … before the {{sec}}s countdown hits zero! Wrong nodes trigger a system glitch.

companion.title: Chat with Ralph
companion.opening: Hi {{name}}! We don't have to play any games. How are you feeling right now? Or we can chat about your favourite things!
companion.activeSub: Tell Ralph how you feel or chat about things you like!
companion.quietSub: Ralph is resting quietly next to you. Say anything to wake him, or he will check in soon.
companion.sleepingMsg: I'm resting right here with you. Tap or talk anytime!
companion.demoCheckinNow: Check in now ("Hey, how are you feeling now?")
companion.checkinLine: Hey, how are you feeling now?
companion.painScaleLabel: How much does it hurt right now? (optional)
companion.inputPlaceholder: Type or tap to talk to Ralph…
